messages.subject: Email/calendar — our current suite is up for renewal in August
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Heads-up: our email/calendar contract renews in August and the quote came in higher than last year. A competitor vendor (Mailmount) sent me an offer:

- Switch cost: €1,900 one-off (migration of mailboxes, calendars, shared contacts)
- Then €4,100/year vs our current renewal at ~€5,300
- They claim shared-mailbox and delegation features are on par

I have no strong opinion on the vendor, but the €1,200/year difference seems worth a look. Before I spend more time on this — do we want to pursue it or just renew? Happy to arrange a demo if so.

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: Email/calendar — our current suite is up for renewal in August
messages.body:
Dear Lena,

Thank you for flagging this. The saving is indeed roughly €1,200 per year, which is not nothing, though I would want us to weigh the migration effort and the risk of disrupting everyone's calendars in the same period as the Ledgerly cutover. A demo would be a sensible next step — but the final call on switching such a company-wide tool is above my remit, so I would defer to Marta.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Email/calendar — our current suite is up for renewal in August
messages.body:
Marta,

Shall I book the Mailmount demo for next week? Say the word and I'll set it up. Otherwise I'll just renew before the early-July deadline and we keep the status quo.

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: Email/calendar — our current suite is up for renewal in August
messages.body: lenaa, saw this on the cc trail. fwiw mailmounts api is meh, no decent hooks for automation. not a blocker, just sayin. migrating mailboxes is a boring weekend nobody wants. can help if it ever happens tho — g (sent from mobile, sorry for typos)

Danke,
